description: Every host the caller's connected Yandex Webmaster OAuth grant can access — the data source for picking which host to bind to a project (see set_yandex_host). Read-only and FREE (no credits). Check `requiresReconnect` before treating an empty `hosts` list as 'no hosts': true means the stored grant can no longer reach Yandex Webmaster.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: list_yandex_hosts
